You can fill in this form in any language. A link or draft is enough to start;
you do not need to write code.

## Guide and language

Give the title, language, author, and link, or paste a draft here. Describe who
the guide helps and which task it covers.

## Version and environment

Which AEA tag or commit and operating system did you use? Include the relevant
Python/MNE or MATLAB/EEGLAB versions, and the agent client and model if used.

## Steps and results

Which steps did you actually try? Link public or synthetic data where relevant,
and describe the expected outputs and the checks you ran. Mention any failed or
incomplete steps and manual fixes.

## Source and changes

Link the official instructions or other sources you followed. Identify changes
to the procedure or analysis settings. If you want the guide included in this
repository, confirm that you authored it or have permission to contribute it.

Before posting, remove credentials, personal information and private participant
data from the guide, logs and screenshots.
